133	def validate_graph_attribution_result(
134	    value: dict[str, Any],
135	    action_graph: dict[str, Any],
136	    event_graph: dict[str, Any],
137	) -> dict[str, Any]:
138	    actions = {
139	        str(item.get("action_id")): item
140	        for item in action_graph.get("actions", [])
141	        if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("action_id")
142	    }
143	    events = {
144	        str(item.get("node_id")): item
145	        for item in event_graph.get("nodes", [])
146	        if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("node_id")
147	    }
148	    event_actions: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
149	    for action_id, action in actions.items():
150	        for event_id in action.get("event_ids", []):
151	            event_actions.setdefault(str(event_id), []).append(action_id)
152	
153	    missing = _string_list(value.get("missing_evidence"))
154	    suspicious_actions = []
155	    seen_actions: set[str] = set()
156	    for item in _dict_list(value.get("suspicious_actions")):
157	        action_id = str(item.get("action_id") or "")
158	        if action_id not in actions:
159	            if action_id:
160	                missing.append(f"Analyzer referenced unknown Action ID: {action_id}")
161	            continue
162	        if action_id in seen_actions:
163	            continue
164	        seen_actions.add(action_id)
165	        suspicious_actions.append({
166	            "action_id": action_id,
167	            "reason": _clip(item.get("reason"), MAX_TEXT_PREVIEW),
168	        })
169	
170	    suspicious_events = []
171	    seen_events: set[str] = set()
172	    for item in _dict_list(value.get("suspicious_events")):
173	        event_id = str(item.get("event_id") or "")
174	        if event_id not in events:
175	            if event_id:
176	                missing.append(f"Analyzer referenced unknown Event ID: {event_id}")
177	            continue
178	        if event_id in seen_events:
179	            continue
180	        seen_events.add(event_id)
181	        requested_action = str(item.get("action_id") or "")
182	        actual_actions = event_actions.get(event_id, [])
183	        adjusted = False
184	        if actual_actions and requested_action not in actual_actions:
185	            requested_action = actual_actions[0]
186	            adjusted = True
187	        elif requested_action not in actions:
188	            requested_action = actual_actions[0] if actual_actions else ""
189	            adjusted = bool(actual_actions)
190	        row = {
191	            "event_id": event_id,
192	            "action_id": requested_action or None,
193	            "reason": _clip(item.get("reason"), MAX_TEXT_PREVIEW),
194	        }
195	        if adjusted:
196	            row["mapping_adjusted"] = True
197	        suspicious_events.append(row)
198	
199	    symptoms = []
200	    for item in _dict_list(value.get("symptoms"))[:6]:
201	        symptoms.append({
202	            "type": _clip(item.get("type"), 80) or "unknown",
203	            "summary": _clip(item.get("summary"), MAX_TEXT_PREVIEW),
204	        })
205	
206	    status = "complete" if suspicious_actions or suspicious_events else "insufficient_evidence"
207	    if status == "insufficient_evidence":
208	        missing.append("Analyzer did not return any valid Action or Event references.")
209	    return {
210	        "available": True,
211	        "status": status,
212	        "symptoms": symptoms,
213	        "suspicious_actions": suspicious_actions,
214	        "suspicious_events": suspicious_events,
215	        "missing_evidence": _dedupe(missing),
216	        "summary": _clip(value.get("summary"), 2000) or "No diagnosis summary was returned.",
217	    }
218

220	def _compact_event(node: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
221	    data = node.get("data") if isinstance(node.get("data"), dict) else {}
222	    tool_input = data.get("tool_input")
223	    return {
224	        "event_id": node.get("node_id"),
225	        "type": node.get("type"),
226	        "label": _clip(node.get("label"), 240),
227	        "timestamp": node.get("timestamp"),
228	        "agent_id": node.get("agent_id"),
229	        "turn_index": data.get("turn_index"),
230	        "tool_name": data.get("tool_name"),
231	        "tool_call_id": data.get("tool_call_id") or data.get("tool_use_id"),
232	        "files": list(data.get("files") or [])[:20],
233	        "command": _clip(data.get("command"), MAX_TEXT_PREVIEW),
234	        "text": _clip(data.get("text"), MAX_TEXT_PREVIEW),
235	        "tool_input": _clip_json(tool_input, MAX_TOOL_INPUT_PREVIEW),
236	        "result_summary": _clip(data.get("result_summary"), MAX_TEXT_PREVIEW),
237	        "is_error": bool(data.get("is_error")),
238	    }

241	def _event_priority(node: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
242	    node_type = str(node.get("type") or "")
243	    data = node.get("data") if isinstance(node.get("data"), dict) else {}
244	    if data.get("is_error") or node_type == "error":
245	        return 100
246	    return {
247	        "file_edit": 90,
248	        "command": 85,
249	        "final_claim": 80,
250	        "tool_result": 75,
251	        "user_message": 70,
252	        "file_read": 45,
253	        "assistant_text": 35,
254	    }.get(node_type, 30)

257	def _unavailable_result(code: str, message: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
258	    return {
259	        "available": False,
260	        "status": "unavailable",
261	        "code": code,
262	        "symptoms": [],
263	        "suspicious_actions": [],
264	        "suspicious_events": [],
265	        "missing_evidence": [message],
266	        "summary": "Feedback diagnosis is unavailable.",
267	    }

270	def _dict_list(value: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
271	    return [item for item in value if isinstance(item, dict)] if isinstance(value, list) else []
272	
273	
274	def _string_list(value: Any) -> list[str]:
275	    return [str(item) for item in value if item] if isinstance(value, list) else []
276

278	def _clip(value: Any, limit: int) -> str | None:
279	    if value is None:
280	        return None
281	    text = str(value).strip()
282	    if not text:
283	        return None
284	    return text if len(text) <= limit else text[: limit - 1] + "…"
285	
286	
287	def _clip_json(value: Any, limit: int) -> Any:
288	    if value in (None, {}, []):
289	        return None
290	    text = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True)
291	    return text if len(text) <= limit else text[: limit - 1] + "…"
292	
293	
294	def _dedupe(values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
295	    seen: set[str] = set()
296	    result = []
297	    for value in values:
298	        if value not in seen:
299	            seen.add(value)
300	            result.append(value)
301	    return result

1	"""Tests for Session graph user-feedback diagnosis."""
2	
3	from __future__ import annotations
4	
5	import json
6	import subprocess
7	import unittest
8	
9	from ccwhat.diagnosis.feedback import (
10	    analyze_graph_feedback,
11	    build_compact_graph_context,
12	    parse_graph_attribution_output,
13	    validate_graph_attribution_result,
14	)
15	
16	
17	ACTION_GRAPH = {
18	    "workflow": "openspec",
19	    "actions": [
20	        {"action_id": "A5", "type": "apply", "status": "observed", "event_ids": ["E40"], "evidence": []},
21	        {"action_id": "A6", "type": "verify", "status": "failed", "event_ids": ["E41"], "evidence": []},
22	    ],
23	    "edges": [],
24	}
25	EVENT_GRAPH = {
26	    "nodes": [
27	        {
28	            "node_id": "E40",
29	            "type": "file_edit",
30	            "label": "Edit routing.py",
31	            "data": {"files": ["routing.py"], "tool_name": "Edit", "tool_input": {"new_string": "wrong"}},
32	        },
33	        {
34	            "node_id": "E41",
35	            "type": "tool_result",
36	            "label": "FAILED routing test",
37	            "data": {"result_summary": "FAILED routing test", "is_error": True},
38	        },
39	    ],
40	    "edges": [],
41	}
42	
43	
44	class GraphFeedbackTests(unittest.TestCase):
45	    def test_compact_context_keeps_graph_ids_and_tool_evidence(self) -> None:
46	        context = json.loads(build_compact_graph_context(ACTION_GRAPH, EVENT_GRAPH))
47	
48	        self.assertEqual(context["actions"][0]["event_ids"], ["E40"])
49	        self.assertEqual(context["events"][0]["event_id"], "E40")
50	        self.assertIn("new_string", context["events"][0]["tool_input"])
51	
52	    def test_parse_accepts_markdown_json_fence(self) -> None:
53	        parsed = parse_graph_attribution_output('```json\n{"summary":"ok"}\n```')
54	        self.assertEqual(parsed["summary"], "ok")
55	
56	    def test_validate_removes_fabricated_ids_and_corrects_mapping(self) -> None:
57	        result = validate_graph_attribution_result(
58	            {
59	                "symptoms": [{"type": "wrong_output", "summary": "wrong route"}],
60	                "suspicious_actions": [
61	                    {"action_id": "A5", "reason": "edited route"},
62	                    {"action_id": "A99", "reason": "invented"},
63	                ],
64	                "suspicious_events": [
65	                    {"event_id": "E40", "action_id": "A6", "reason": "wrong implementation"},
66	                    {"event_id": "E999", "action_id": "A5", "reason": "invented"},
67	                ],
68	                "missing_evidence": [],
69	                "summary": "Apply is suspicious.",
70	            },
71	            ACTION_GRAPH,
72	            EVENT_GRAPH,
73	        )
74	
75	        self.assertEqual(result["status"], "complete")
76	        self.assertEqual([item["action_id"] for item in result["suspicious_actions"]], ["A5"])
77	        self.assertEqual([item["event_id"] for item in result["suspicious_events"]], ["E40"])
78	        self.assertEqual(result["suspicious_events"][0]["action_id"], "A5")
79	        self.assertTrue(result["suspicious_events"][0]["mapping_adjusted"])
80	        self.assertTrue(any("A99" in item for item in result["missing_evidence"]))
81	        self.assertTrue(any("E999" in item for item in result["missing_evidence"]))
82	
83	    def test_analyze_reuses_local_analyzer_runner_once(self) -> None:
84	        raw = json.dumps({
85	            "symptoms": [{"type": "validation_failed", "summary": "test failed"}],
86	            "suspicious_actions": [{"action_id": "A6", "reason": "failed verification"}],
87	            "suspicious_events": [{"event_id": "E41", "action_id": "A6", "reason": "failed result"}],
88	            "missing_evidence": [],
89	            "summary": "Verification failed.",
90	        })
91	        calls = []
92	
93	        def runner(command, **kwargs):
94	            calls.append((command, kwargs))
95	            return subprocess.CompletedProcess(command, 0, stdout=raw, stderr="")
96	
97	        result = analyze_graph_feedback(
98	            feedback="The routing test failed",
99	            action_graph=ACTION_GRAPH,
100	            event_graph=EVENT_GRAPH,
101	            analyzer_agent="claude",
102	            runner=runner,
103	        )
104	
105	        self.assertTrue(result["available"])
106	        self.assertEqual(result["suspicious_events"][0]["event_id"], "E41")
107	        self.assertEqual(len(calls), 1)
108	        self.assertTrue(calls[0][0][0].endswith("claude"))
109	        self.assertEqual(calls[0][0][1], "-p")
110	        self.assertIn("The routing test failed", calls[0][1]["input"])
111	
112	    def test_analyzer_failure_returns_structured_unavailable_result(self) -> None:
113	        def runner(command, **kwargs):
114	            raise FileNotFoundError(command[0])
115	
116	        result = analyze_graph_feedback(
117	            feedback="wrong output",
118	            action_graph=ACTION_GRAPH,
119	            event_graph=EVENT_GRAPH,
120	            analyzer_agent="claude",
121	            runner=runner,
122	        )
123	
124	        self.assertFalse(result["available"])
125	        self.assertEqual(result["code"], "analyzer_not_found")
126	        self.assertFalse(result["suspicious_events"])
127	
128	
129	if __name__ == "__main__":
130	    unittest.main()

24	
25	**Steps**
26	
27	1. **If no clear input provided, ask what they want to build**
28	
29	   Use the **AskUserQuestion tool** (open-ended, no preset options) to ask:
30	   > "What change do you want to work on? Describe what you want to build or fix."
31	
32	   From their description, derive a kebab-case name (e.g., "add user authentication" → `add-user-auth`).
33	
34	   **IMPORTANT**: Do NOT proceed without understanding what the user wants to build.
35	
36	2. **Create the change directory**
37	   ```bash
38	   openspec new change "<name>"
39	   ```
40	   This creates a scaffolded change at `openspec/changes/<name>/` with `.openspec.yaml`.
41	   Then initialize the OpenSpec workflow graph:
42	   ```bash
43	   ccwhat openspec-graph sync --change "<name>" --event change_created --note "openspec new change"
44	   ```
45	
46	3. **Get the artifact build order**
47	   ```bash
48	   openspec status --change "<name>" --json
49	   ```
50	   Parse the JSON to get:
51	   - `applyRequires`: array of artifact IDs needed before implementation (e.g., `["tasks"]`)
52	   - `artifacts`: list of all artifacts with their status and dependencies
53	
54	4. **Create artifacts in sequence until apply-ready**
55	
56	   Use the **TodoWrite tool** to track progress through the artifacts.
57	
58	   Loop through artifacts in dependency order (artifacts with no pending dependencies first):
59	
60	   a. **For each artifact that is `ready` (dependencies satisfied)**:
61	      - Get instructions:
62	        ```bash
63	        openspec instructions <artifact-id> --change "<name>" --json
64	        ```
65	      - The instructions JSON includes:
66	        - `context`: Project background (constraints for you - do NOT include in output)
67	        - `rules`: Artifact-specific rules (constraints for you - do NOT include in output)
68	        - `template`: The structure to use for your output file
69	        - `instruction`: Schema-specific guidance for this artifact type
70	        - `outputPath`: Where to write the artifact
71	        - `dependencies`: Completed artifacts to read for context
72	      - Read any completed dependency files for context
73	      - Create the artifact file using `template` as the structure
74	      - Apply `context` and `rules` as constraints - but do NOT copy them into the file
75	      - Sync the OpenSpec graph after writing the artifact:
76	        ```bash
77	        ccwhat openspec-graph sync --change "<name>" --event artifact_created --artifact "<artifact-id>"
78	        ```
79	      - Show brief progress: "Created <artifact-id>"
80	
81	   b. **Continue until all `applyRequires` artifacts are complete**
82	      - After creating each artifact, re-run `openspec status --change "<name>" --json`
83	      - Check if every artifact ID in `applyRequires` has `status: "done"` in the artifacts array
84	      - Stop when all `applyRequires` artifacts are done
85	
86	   c. **If an artifact requires user input** (unclear context):
87	      - Use **AskUserQuestion tool** to clarify
88	      - Then continue with creation
89	
90	5. **Show final status**
91	   ```bash
92	   openspec status --change "<name>"
93	   ```
94	   Then sync the graph one final time:
95	   ```bash
96	   ccwhat openspec-graph sync --change "<name>"
97	   ```
98	
99	**Output**
100	
101	After completing all artifacts, summarize:
102	- Change name and location
103	- List of artifacts created with brief descriptions
104	- What's ready: "All artifacts created! Ready for implementation."
105	- Prompt: "Run `/opsx:apply` or ask me to implement to start working on the tasks."
106	
107	**Artifact Creation Guidelines**
108	
109	- Follow the `instruction` field from `openspec instructions` for each artifact type
110	- The schema defines what each artifact should contain - follow it
111	- Read dependency artifacts for context before creating new ones
112	- Use `template` as the structure for your output file - fill in its sections
113	- **IMPORTANT**: `context` and `rules` are constraints for YOU, not content for the file
114	  - Do NOT copy `<context>`, `<rules>`, `<project_context>` blocks into the artifact
115	  - These guide what you write, but should never appear in the output
116	
117	**Guardrails**
118	- Create ALL artifacts needed for implementation (as defined by schema's `apply.requires`)
119	- Always read dependency artifacts before creating a new one
120	- If context is critically unclear, ask the user - but prefer making reasonable decisions to keep momentum
121	- If a change with that name already exists, ask if user wants to continue it or create a new one
122	- Verify each artifact file exists after writing before proceeding to next
123	- Keep `openspec/changes/<name>/graph/` synchronized by running `ccwhat openspec-graph sync` after each workflow milestone

1	## Why
2	
3	现有 OpenSpec Graph 已能从 Claude Code Session 生成固定七节点 Action Graph 和 step-level Event Graph，但产品尚未形成“用户描述问题 -> 定位可疑 Action -> 定位具体 Event -> 输出可回看证据的报告”闭环。
4	
5	原有 change 计划继续扩展 Action/Event 规则打分，但这会在 MVP 阶段引入大量无法校准的权重和因果假设。当前最需要验证的是：仅使用一个 OpenSpec change 对应的一份 Claude Code 原始 Session，复用项目现有 Analyzer Adapter 启动一次本地 AI CLI 非交互分析，是否已经能给用户提供有价值的粗到细诊断。
6	
7	## What Changes
8	
9	- 保留固定 OpenSpec 七节点 Action Graph，只把状态收敛为 `observed|not_observed|failed`，不再使用流程距离产生根因分数。
10	- 加固基于 Claude Code 原始 Session 的 Event Graph：唯一 Event ID、Tool Call/Result 配对、文件/命令/错误/result summary 和 raw reference。
11	- 修正 Event 到 Action 的最小映射规则，保留映射理由，未映射 Event 不丢失。
12	- 新增用户反馈归因入口：输入 `session_id`、`change` 和自然语言 feedback。
13	- 复用 `run_mc_analysis()` 和 Analyzer Registry，启动一次本地 Claude/Codex/OpenCode CLI 非交互会话；不新增模型 API Client 或 API Key 配置。
14	- Analyzer 输出严格结构化诊断，程序校验所有 Action/Event 引用并删除编造 ID。
15	- Viewer 增加反馈输入、诊断报告，以及从报告定位粗图 Action 和细图 Event 的交互。
16	- 提供一个真实结构的 OpenSpec 驱动 Claude Code Session mock，用于前端手动验收。
17	
18	## Non-Goals
19	
20	- 不接 Runtime Task、Task Dataset、Dataset export 或 `task.diff`。
21	- 不支持一个 Session 中包含多个 OpenSpec change。
22	- 不引入 Action Contract、Action Run、多模板适配器或 Artifact/Requirement/Outcome 图。
23	- 不实现复杂因果边、反事实执行、规则投票或数值 root-cause score。
24	- 不调用模型 HTTP API；本 change 只复用用户本机已安装并已登录的 AI CLI。
25	- 不让 Analyzer 修改代码或自动修复问题。
26

tool_input.content:
## Why

真实用户复现反馈：ccwhat/diagnosis/feedback.py 中 `analyze_graph_feedback` 第一次调用 Analyzer 后，模型可能返回近似 JSON，但字符串内复制了未转义的双引号，导致 `parse_graph_attribution_output` 抛出 `Expecting comma delimiter` 错误，Viewer 无法生成诊断。当前代码仅做一次解析尝试，失败即降级为 `unavailable`，浪费了可用但不合规的模型输出。需要在不增加 Analyzer 调用次数约束的前提下，允许一次可逆的格式修复调用，提升调试可用性。

## What Changes

- `analyze_graph_feedback` 调整设计约束：从一次主分析调用调整为**一次主分析 + 最多一次格式修复调用**（即主分析输出非法 JSON 时，调用一次专用修复提示）。
- 新增一次专用格式修复子调用逻辑：仅在首次 `parse_graph_attribution_output` 抛出 `ValueError` 时允许触发；修复提示要求只修正 JSON 语法错误（不增加新事实、不改变语义），并携带原始输出和解析异常信息。
- 第二次解析仍非法则复用现有 `_unavailable_result` 降级通道。
- 首次解析合法不产生第二次调用。
- 所有 Action/Event 引用校验仍必须通过现有的 `validate_graph_attribution_result`。
- 新增三人测试组：未转义引号导致首次失败后修复成功、首次合法只调用一次、第二次仍失败时降级。
- 更新当前 change 的 design.md 设计约束："一次主分析调用" → "一次主分析加最多一次格式修复调用"。

## Capabilities

### New Capabilities
- `graph-feedback-json-fix`: 允许一次 JSON 格式修复子调用，在模型输出近似 JSON 时挽救诊断结果。

### Modified Capabilities
- 无

## Impact

- **代码**: `ccwhat/diagnosis/feedback.py` 的 `analyze_graph_feedback` 函数逻辑调整，新增修复调用的工厂函数或内联逻辑。
- **测试**: `tests/test_graph_feedback.py` 新增三个测试用例。
- **设计文档**: `openspec/changes/harden-graph-feedback-json-retry/design.md` 更新调用次数约束。

43	- **WHEN** `graph/events.jsonl` contains milestone events and session step evidence is available
44	- **THEN** milestone events SHALL be stored as supplemental evidence or graph metadata
45	- **AND** milestone events SHALL NOT replace the step-level Event Graph main nodes
46

48	
49	系统 SHALL explain why each Event maps to each OpenSpec Action.
50	
51	#### Scenario: Mapping reason output
52	- **WHEN** an Event is mapped to an Action
53	- **THEN** Action evidence SHALL include the mapped event id
54	- **AND** Action evidence SHALL include a reason such as `path:proposal`, `path:spec`, `path:design`, `path:tasks`, `command:openspec_validate`, `command:test`, `command:openspec_archive`, `event:file_change`, or `unmapped_turn`

tool_input.content:
## Context

当前 `ccwhat/diagnosis/feedback.py` 的 `analyze_graph_feedback` 设计约束为"只调用一次 Analyzer"。真实用户运行时，Analyzer（Claude/Codex CLI）首次输出可能包含近似 JSON——结构正确但字符串内嵌了未转义的双引号字符。`parse_graph_attribution_output` 的 `json.loads` / `raw_decode` 在此场景下报 `Expecting comma delimiter` 错误，整个诊断降级为 `unavailable`，Viewer 无法展示任何结果。

实际上，首次输出的信息内容基本正确，仅 JSON 语法不合法。如果允许用一次专有格式修复小调用纠正语法，可以挽救大量本可用的诊断结果。

本 change 调整 Analyzer 调用流程为"一次主分析 + 最多一次格式修复调用"，且修复调用严格限定为纯 JSON 语法修复，不得引入新事实。

## Goals / Non-Goals

**Goals:**
- Analyzer 首次输出解析失败时，允许且仅允许一次格式修复子调用。
- 修复提示必须只修正 JSON 语法错误，不改变语义、不增加新事实。
- 修复提示携带原始输出和解析异常信息。
- 第二次解析仍非法则沿用现有 `_unavailable_result` 降级。
- 首次解析合法不产生第二次调用。
- 所有 Action/Event 引用仍然经过 `validate_graph_attribution_result`。
- 补测试覆盖三个场景：未转义引号首次失败后修复成功、首次合法只调用一次、第二次仍失败降级。

**Non-Goals:**
- 不增加超过一次额外的格式修复调用（即最多两次 Analyzer 总调用）。
- 不改动 `parse_graph_attribution_output` 或 `validate_graph_attribution_result` 的签名或行为。
- 不引入新的依赖或外部库。
- 不改变 Analyzer Registry 或 `run_mc_analysis` 接口。
- 不修改 Viewer 前端代码。

## Decisions

### Decision: 修复调用复用现有 `run_mc_analysis` 管道

格式修复调用与主分析调用使用相同的 `run_mc_analysis()` 函数和相同的 CLI 上下文（analyzer_cmd/agent/timeout/runner）。不创建新的 MCP 或 API 调用路径。

**替代方案考虑：**
- 使用纯本地字符串修复器（正则/简单替换）：不可靠，无法处理模型输出的复杂嵌套字符串。
- 使用内联修复（在同一个子进程中追加提示语）：需要侵入 `run_mc_analysis` 签名，与现有抽象不一致。

**选择：** 复用 `run_mc_analysis`。修复提示是独立的 prompt 文本，调用即可。

### Decision: 修复提示通过新 asset 文件承载

创建 `ccwhat/assets/graph_attribution_fix_prompt.md` 作为独立 asset 文件，与主提示 `graph_attribution_prompt.md` 平行。提示内容：
- 要求只修正 JSON 语法错误，不改变语义、不增加字段。
- 说明错误类型（Expecting comma delimiter 等），附上原始输出。
- 输出必须是合法 JSON 对象（与主提示相同的 schema 约束）。
- 必须在 ```json ... ``` fence 内输出。

**替代方案考虑：**
- 硬编码在 feedback.py 中：可行，但违背项目一致风格（主提示使用 asset 文件）。
- 复用主提示并附加指令：混入原本的诊断请求，可能诱导模型重新分析而非仅修语法。

**选择：** 独立 asset 文件。

### Decision: 修复流程嵌入 `analyze_graph_feedback` 内部

格式修复逻辑作为 `analyze_graph_feedback` 内的 try/except 扩展，不提取为独立函数。原因是：
- 调用路径完全绑定于 `analyze_graph_feedback` 的 try/except 结构。
- 提取新函数会增加一次重试所需的参数传递复杂度（prompt、raw 输出、错误信息），且没有其他地方复用此逻辑。
- 保持改动外科手术式——只改变一处函数的控制流。

**流程伪代码：**
```
def analyze_graph_feedback(...):
    raw, elapsed_ms = run_mc_analysis(...)      # 主分析
    try:
        parsed = parse_graph_attribution_output(raw)
    except ValueError as exc:
        fix_prompt = build_fix_prompt(raw, exc)  # 格式修复提示
        fixed_raw, _ = run_mc_analysis(...)      # 格式修复调用
        try:
            parsed = parse_graph_attribution_output(fixed_raw)
        except ValueError as exc2:
            return _unavailable_result(...)       # 第二次仍失败，降级
    result = validate_graph_attribution_result(parsed, ...)  # 校验引用
    ...
```

### Decision: 原有设计约束从"一次主分析调用"更新为"一次主分析加最多一次格式修复调用"

对应更新 design.md 中的相关描述，确保设计文档与实际行为一致。

## Risks / Trade-offs

- **[开销]** 格式修复调用消耗一次附加的模型推理（约一次 round trip）。但仅在首次解析失败时发生，正常路径无额外开销。对于需要修复的 case，增加一次 token 消耗换取完整诊断结果的价值更为重要。
- **[修复失败]** 二次修复仍可能失败。设计明确在此情况下降级，避免无限重试循环。
- **[修复污染]** 修复提示可能引导模型重写而非仅修语法。通过严格要求"只修正 JSON 语法，不改变语义、不新增字段"并将这个约束写入 prompt asset 来缓解。
- **[可测试性]** 测试需要模拟一次错误输出和一次修复输出。可以通过 `runner` 参数控制行为：第一次返回非法 JSON，第二次返回合法 JSON。

220	        get_candidates,
221	        prepare_candidate,
222	    )
223	
224	    normalized_agent = _resolve_analyzer_agent(agent, default_agent=default_agent)
225	    spec, resolved_cmd = _analyze_spec(cmd, agent=normalized_agent)
226	    effective_timeout = _resolve_analyzer_timeout(timeout, spec=spec)
227	    env_cmd = _os.environ.get("CCWHAT_ANALYZE_CMD", "").strip()
228	
229	    has_cmd_source = bool(cmd) or bool(env_cmd)
230	
231	    # If explicit cmd or env override, use it directly (no fallback)
232	    if has_cmd_source:
233	        run = runner or subprocess.run
234	        return _run_one_try(prompt, resolved_cmd, effective_timeout, spec, run)
235	
236	    # No explicit cmd — use the primary spec
237	    if spec is None:
238	        raise AnalysisError(
239	            f"Analyzer protocol is not supported for agent '{normalized_agent}'. "
240	            f"Supported agents: {', '.join(_list_analyzer_names())}",
241	            "analyzer_not_supported",
242	        )
243	
244	    run = runner or subprocess.run
245	    candidates = get_candidates(normalized_agent)
246	    if not candidates:
247	        # No fallback candidates — try the primary spec once
248	        return _run_one_try(prompt, resolved_cmd, effective_timeout, spec, run)
249	
250	    # Try primary spec first, then fallback candidates
251	    last_error: AnalysisError | None = None
252	    try:
253	        return _run_one_try(prompt, resolved_cmd, effective_timeout, spec, run)
254	    except (AnalysisError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as primary_err:
255	        cmd_not_found = isinstance(primary_err, AnalysisError) and primary_err.code == "analyzer_not_found"
256	        if cmd_not_found:
257	            raise
258	        last_error = _as_analysis_error(primary_err, effective_timeout)
259	
260	    # Try fallback candidates
261	    _cleanup_dirs: list[str] = []
262	    try:
263	        for candidate in candidates:
264	            try:
265	                cand_cmd, extra = prepare_candidate(candidate)
266	                _cleanup_dirs.append(str(Path(extra.get("last_message_file", "")).parent))
267	                candidate_timeout = _resolve_analyzer_timeout(timeout, spec=candidate)
268	                result = _run_one_try(prompt, cand_cmd, candidate_timeout, candidate, run, extra_files=extra)
269	                return result
270	            except (AnalysisError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as fallback_err:

275	                last_error = _as_analysis_error(fallback_err, candidate_timeout)
276	                continue

283	                except Exception:
284	                    pass

286	    if last_error:

289	            f"Analyzer agent: {normalized_agent} (experimental={spec.experimental}). "

            raise FileNotFoundError(command[0])

            feedback="wrong output",

            event_graph=EVENT_GRAPH,

        self.assertEqual(result["code"], "analyzer_not_found")
        self.assertFalse(result["suspicious_events"])

    def test_first_parse_fails_then_fix_succeeds(self) -> None:
        """Unescaped quotes cause first parse failure, format fix recovers."""
        raw_valid = json.dumps({
            "symptoms": [{"type": "validation_failed", "summary": "test failed"}],
            "suspicious_actions": [{"action_id": "A6", "reason": "failed verification"}],
            "suspicious_events": [{"event_id": "E41", "action_id": "A6", "reason": "failed result"}],
            "missing_evidence": [],
            "summary": "Verification failed.",
        })
        raw_broken = '{"summary": "contains unescaped "quotes" inside"}'

        calls = []

        def runner(command, **kwargs):
            calls.append((command, kwargs))
            # First call returns broken JSON, second call returns valid JSON
            if len(calls) == 1:
                return subprocess.CompletedProcess(command, 0, stdout=raw_broken, stderr="")
            return subprocess.CompletedProcess(command, 0, stdout=raw_valid, stderr="")

        result = analyze_graph_feedback(
            feedback="The routing test failed",
            action_graph=ACTION_GRAPH,
            event_graph=EVENT_GRAPH,
            analyzer_agent="claude",
            runner=runner,
        )

        self.assertTrue(result["available"])
        self.assertEqual(result["suspicious_events"][0]["event_id"], "E41")
        # One main analysis + one format fix = 2 calls
        self.assertEqual(len(calls), 2)

        """First parse succeeds → no second Analyzer call."""
        raw_valid = json.dumps({
            "symptoms": [{"type": "validation_failed", "summary": "test failed"}],
            "suspicious_actions": [{"action_id": "A6", "reason": "failed verification"}],
            "suspicious_events": [{"event_id": "E41", "action_id": "A6", "reason": "failed result"}],
            "missing_evidence": [],
            "summary": "Verification failed.",
        })

        calls = []

        def runner(command, **kwargs):
            calls.append((command, kwargs))
            return subprocess.CompletedProcess(command, 0, stdout=raw_valid, stderr="")

        result = analyze_graph_feedback(
            feedback="The routing test failed",
            action_graph=ACTION_GRAPH,
            event_graph=EVENT_GRAPH,
            analyzer_agent="claude",
            runner=runner,
        )

        self.assertTrue(result["available"])
        self.assertEqual(len(calls), 1)

    def test_fix_also_fails_degrades(self) -> None:
        """Both first and fix attempt return broken JSON → unavailable."""
        raw_broken = '{"summary": "contains unescaped "quotes" inside"}'

        calls = []

        def runner(command, **kwargs):
            calls.append((command, kwargs))
            return subprocess.CompletedProcess(command, 0, stdout=raw_broken, stderr="")

        result = analyze_graph_feedback(
            feedback="The routing test failed",
            action_graph=ACTION_GRAPH,
            event_graph=EVENT_GRAPH,
            analyzer_agent="claude",
            runner=runner,
        )

        self.assertFalse(result["available"])
        self.assertEqual(result["status"], "unavailable")
        self.assertEqual(result["code"], "invalid_analyzer_json")
        self.assertEqual(len(calls), 2)

1	"""User-feedback diagnosis over one Session-bound OpenSpec graph."""
2	
3	from __future__ import annotations
4	
5	import json
6	import re
7	from importlib import resources
8	from typing import Any
9	
10	from ccwhat.analyzer import AnalysisError, run_mc_analysis
11	
12	
13	MAX_GRAPH_CONTEXT_CHARS = 28_000
14	MAX_TEXT_PREVIEW = 700
15	MAX_TOOL_INPUT_PREVIEW = 900
16	
17	
18	def analyze_graph_feedback(
19	    *,
20	    feedback: str,
21	    action_graph: dict[str, Any],
22	    event_graph: dict[str, Any],
23	    analyzer_cmd: list[str] | tuple[str, ...] | None = None,
24	    analyzer_agent: str | None = None,
25	    analyzer_timeout: int | float | None = None,
26	    runner: Any | None = None,
27	) -> dict[str, Any]:
28	    """Run one local Analyzer CLI session and return validated graph references.
29	
30	    If the first Analyzer output is not valid JSON (e.g. unescaped quotes in
31	    string values), one automatic format-fix attempt is made.  If that also
32	    fails the diagnosis gracefully degrades to ``_unavailable_result``.
33	    """
34	    prompt = build_graph_attribution_prompt(feedback, action_graph, event_graph)
35	    try:
36	        raw, elapsed_ms = run_mc_analysis(
37	            prompt,
38	            cmd=analyzer_cmd,
39	            agent=analyzer_agent,
40	            timeout=analyzer_timeout,
41	            runner=runner,
42	        )
43	    except AnalysisError as exc:
44	        return _unavailable_result(exc.code, exc.message)
45	
46	    try:
47	        parsed = parse_graph_attribution_output(raw)
48	    except ValueError as exc:
49	        # One allowed format-fix attempt — only fix JSON syntax, no new facts.
50	        fix_prompt = build_graph_attribution_fix_prompt(raw, exc)
51	        try:
52	            fixed_raw, fix_elapsed = run_mc_analysis(
53	                fix_prompt,
54	                cmd=analyzer_cmd,
55	                agent=analyzer_agent,
56	                timeout=analyzer_timeout,
57	                runner=runner,
58	            )
59	        except AnalysisError as fix_exc:
60	            return _unavailable_result(fix_exc.code, fix_exc.message)
61	        try:
62	            parsed = parse_graph_attribution_output(fixed_raw)
63	        except ValueError as exc2:
64	            return _unavailable_result("invalid_analyzer_json", str(exc2))
65	        elapsed_ms += fix_elapsed
66	
67	    result = validate_graph_attribution_result(parsed, action_graph, event_graph)
68	    result["elapsed_ms"] = elapsed_ms
69	    result["analyzer_agent"] = analyzer_agent or "claude"
70	    return result
71	
72	
73	def build_graph_attribution_fix_prompt(raw: str, error: ValueError) -> str:
74	    """Build a prompt asking the model to only fix JSON syntax in *raw*."""
75	    template = (
76	        resources.files("ccwhat")
77	        .joinpath("assets/graph_attribution_fix_prompt.md")
78	        .read_text(encoding="utf-8")
79	    )
80	    return (
81	        template.replace("{{original_output}}", raw.strip())
82	        .replace("{{parse_error}}", str(error))
83	    )
84	
85	
86	def build_graph_attribution_prompt(
87	    feedback: str,
88	    action_graph: dict[str, Any],
89	    event_graph: dict[str, Any],
90	) -> str:
91	    template = resources.files("ccwhat").joinpath("assets/graph_attribution_prompt.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
92	    context = build_compact_graph_context(action_graph, event_graph)
93	    return template.replace("{{feedback}}", feedback.strip()).replace("{{graph_context}}", context)
94	
95	
96	def build_compact_graph_context(
97	    action_graph: dict[str, Any],
98	    event_graph: dict[str, Any],
99	) -> str:
100	    actions = [item for item in action_graph.get("actions", []) if isinstance(item, dict)]
101	    nodes = [item for item in event_graph.get("nodes", []) if isinstance(item, dict)]
102	
103	    ranked = sorted(enumerate(nodes), key=lambda item: (-_event_priority(item[1]), item[0]))
104	    selected_indexes: set[int] = set()
105	    used = 0
106	    compact_by_index: dict[int, dict[str, Any]] = {}
107	    for index, node in ranked:
108	        compact = _compact_event(node)
109	        size = len(json.dumps(compact, ensure_ascii=False))
110	        if used + size > MAX_GRAPH_CONTEXT_CHARS and selected_indexes:
111	            continue
112	        selected_indexes.add(index)
113	        compact_by_index[index] = compact
114	        used += size
115	
116	    selected_events = [compact_by_index[index] for index in sorted(selected_indexes)]
117	    selected_ids = {str(item.get("event_id") or "") for item in selected_events}
118	    compact_actions = []
119	    for action in actions:
120	        event_ids = [str(value) for value in action.get("event_ids", []) if str(value) in selected_ids]
121	        compact_actions.append({
122	            "action_id": action.get("action_id"),
123	            "type": action.get("type"),
124	            "status": action.get("status"),
125	            "event_ids": event_ids,
126	            "mapping_reasons": [
127	                item.get("reason")
128	                for item in action.get("evidence", [])
129	                if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("reason")
130	            ][:12],
131	        })
132	
133	    return json.dumps(
134	        {
135	            "actions": compact_actions,
136	            "events": selected_events,
137	            "omitted_event_count": max(0, len(nodes) - len(selected_events)),
138	            "source_note": "Claude Code raw Session behavior; final repository state is not verified",
139	        },
140	        ensure_ascii=False,
141	        indent=2,
142	    )
143	
144	
145	def parse_graph_attribution_output(raw: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
146	    text = str(raw or "").strip()
147	    if not text:
148	        raise ValueError("Analyzer returned empty diagnosis output.")
149	
150	    fenced = re.search(r"```(?:json)?\s*(\{.*?\})\s*```", text, flags=re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL)
151	    candidate = fenced.group(1) if fenced else text
152	    try:
153	        value = json.loads(candidate)
154	    except json.JSONDecodeError:
155	        start = candidate.find("{")
156	        if start < 0:
157	            raise ValueError("Analyzer output does not contain a JSON object.") from None
158	        try:
159	            value, _ = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(candidate[start:])
160	        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
161	            raise ValueError(f"Analyzer output is not valid diagnosis JSON: {exc.msg}.") from exc
162	    if not isinstance(value, dict):
163	        raise ValueError("Analyzer diagnosis JSON must be an object.")
164	    return value
165	
166	
167	def validate_graph_attribution_result(
168	    value: dict[str, Any],
169	    action_graph: dict[str, Any],
170	    event_graph: dict[str, Any],
171	) -> dict[str, Any]:
172	    actions = {
173	        str(item.get("action_id")): item
174	        for item in action_graph.get("actions", [])
175	        if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("action_id")
176	    }
177	    events = {
178	        str(item.get("node_id")): item
179	        for item in event_graph.get("nodes", [])
180	        if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("node_id")
181	    }
182	    event_actions: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
183	    for action_id, action in actions.items():
184	        for event_id in action.get("event_ids", []):
185	            event_actions.setdefault(str(event_id), []).append(action_id)
186	
187	    missing = _string_list(value.get("missing_evidence"))
188	    suspicious_actions = []
189	    seen_actions: set[str] = set()
190	    for item in _dict_list(value.get("suspicious_actions")):
191	        action_id = str(item.get("action_id") or "")
192	        if action_id not in actions:
193	            if action_id:
194	                missing.append(f"Analyzer referenced unknown Action ID: {action_id}")
195	            continue
196	        if action_id in seen_actions:
197	            continue
198	        seen_actions.add(action_id)
199	        suspicious_actions.append({
200	            "action_id": action_id,
201	            "reason": _clip(item.get("reason"), MAX_TEXT_PREVIEW),
202	        })
203	
204	    suspicious_events = []
205	    seen_events: set[str] = set()
206	    for item in _dict_list(value.get("suspicious_events")):
207	        event_id = str(item.get("event_id") or "")
208	        if event_id not in events:
209	            if event_id:
210	                missing.append(f"Analyzer referenced unknown Event ID: {event_id}")
211	            continue
212	        if event_id in seen_events:
213	            continue
214	        seen_events.add(event_id)
215	        requested_action = str(item.get("action_id") or "")
216	        actual_actions = event_actions.get(event_id, [])
217	        adjusted = False
218	        if actual_actions and requested_action not in actual_actions:
219	            requested_action = actual_actions[0]
220	            adjusted = True
221	        elif requested_action not in actions:
222	            requested_action = actual_actions[0] if actual_actions else ""
223	            adjusted = bool(actual_actions)
224	        row = {
225	            "event_id": event_id,
226	            "action_id": requested_action or None,
227	            "reason": _clip(item.get("reason"), MAX_TEXT_PREVIEW),
228	        }
229	        if adjusted:
230	            row["mapping_adjusted"] = True
231	        suspicious_events.append(row)
232	
233	    symptoms = []
234	    for item in _dict_list(value.get("symptoms"))[:6]:
235	        symptoms.append({
236	            "type": _clip(item.get("type"), 80) or "unknown",
237	            "summary": _clip(item.get("summary"), MAX_TEXT_PREVIEW),
238	        })
239	
240	    status = "complete" if suspicious_actions or suspicious_events else "insufficient_evidence"
241	    if status == "insufficient_evidence":
242	        missing.append("Analyzer did not return any valid Action or Event references.")
243	    return {
244	        "available": True,
245	        "status": status,
246	        "symptoms": symptoms,
247	        "suspicious_actions": suspicious_actions,
248	        "suspicious_events": suspicious_events,
249	        "missing_evidence": _dedupe(missing),
250	        "summary": _clip(value.get("summary"), 2000) or "No diagnosis summary was returned.",
251	    }
252	
253	
254	def _compact_event(node: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
255	    data = node.get("data") if isinstance(node.get("data"), dict) else {}
256	    tool_input = data.get("tool_input")
257	    return {
258	        "event_id": node.get("node_id"),
259	        "type": node.get("type"),
260	        "label": _clip(node.get("label"), 240),
261	        "timestamp": node.get("timestamp"),
262	        "agent_id": node.get("agent_id"),
263	        "turn_index": data.get("turn_index"),
264	        "tool_name": data.get("tool_name"),
265	        "tool_call_id": data.get("tool_call_id") or data.get("tool_use_id"),
266	        "files": list(data.get("files") or [])[:20],
267	        "command": _clip(data.get("command"), MAX_TEXT_PREVIEW),
268	        "text": _clip(data.get("text"), MAX_TEXT_PREVIEW),
269	        "tool_input": _clip_json(tool_input, MAX_TOOL_INPUT_PREVIEW),
270	        "result_summary": _clip(data.get("result_summary"), MAX_TEXT_PREVIEW),
271	        "is_error": bool(data.get("is_error")),
272	    }
273	
274	
275	def _event_priority(node: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
276	    node_type = str(node.get("type") or "")
277	    data = node.get("data") if isinstance(node.get("data"), dict) else {}
278	    if data.get("is_error") or node_type == "error":
279	        return 100
280	    return {
281	        "file_edit": 90,
282	        "command": 85,
283	        "final_claim": 80,
284	        "tool_result": 75,
285	        "user_message": 70,
286	        "file_read": 45,
287	        "assistant_text": 35,
288	    }.get(node_type, 30)
289	
290	
291	def _unavailable_result(code: str, message: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
292	    return {
293	        "available": False,
294	        "status": "unavailable",
295	        "code": code,
296	        "symptoms": [],
297	        "suspicious_actions": [],
298	        "suspicious_events": [],
299	        "missing_evidence": [message],
300	        "summary": "Feedback diagnosis is unavailable.",
301	    }
302	
303	
304	def _dict_list(value: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
305	    return [item for item in value if isinstance(item, dict)] if isinstance(value, list) else []
306	
307	
308	def _string_list(value: Any) -> list[str]:
309	    return [str(item) for item in value if item] if isinstance(value, list) else []
310	
311	
312	def _clip(value: Any, limit: int) -> str | None:
313	    if value is None:
314	        return None
315	    text = str(value).strip()
316	    if not text:
317	        return None
318	    return text if len(text) <= limit else text[: limit - 1] + "…"
319	
320	
321	def _clip_json(value: Any, limit: int) -> Any:
322	    if value in (None, {}, []):
323	        return None
324	    text = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True)
325	    return text if len(text) <= limit else text[: limit - 1] + "…"
326	
327	
328	def _dedupe(values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
329	    seen: set[str] = set()
330	    result = []
331	    for value in values:
332	        if value not in seen:
333	            seen.add(value)
334	            result.append(value)
335	    return result

## 总结

### 改动文件

| 文件 | 操作 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| `ccwhat/assets/graph_attribution_fix_prompt.md` | **新增** | 格式修复 prompt asset，要求仅修复 JSON 语法错误，不新增字段/事实 |
| `ccwhat/diagnosis/feedback.py` | **修改** | `analyze_graph_feedback` 增加一次格式修复子调用逻辑；新增 `build_graph_attribution_fix_prompt` 函数 |
| `tests/test_graph_feedback.py` | **修改** | 新增三个测试用例 |
| `openspec/changes/harden-graph-feedback-json-retry/` | **新增** | OpenSpec change 文档：proposal.md、design.md、spec、tasks.md |

### 实现要点

1. **`analyze_graph_feedback`** 从"一次主分析"调整为"一次主分析 + 最多一次格式修复调用"：
   - 首次 `parse_graph_attribution_output` 抛出 `ValueError` 时，构造修复 prompt 并调 `run_mc_analysis` 一次
   - 修复 prompt 通过 `build_graph_attribution_fix_prompt(raw, exc)` 生成，加载 `graph_attribution_fix_prompt.md` asset，填写原始输出和解析错误
   - 第二次解析仍失败则降级返回 `_unavailable_result`
   - 首次解析合法不产生第二次调用
   - 两次 elapsed_ms 累加
   - 所有 Action/Event 引用仍经过 `validate_graph_attribution_result`

2. **更新设计约束**：`design.md` Decision 区块明确标注"一次主分析加最多一次格式修复调用"
